震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
texts.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.

sections.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName].

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.

texts.zh:
在[from.Planet.GetName]的撞击坑中的发掘工作中找到了一些碎片。就是这些碎片释放出我们之前在轨道上探测到的强力引力辐射。

在通往地下洞穴网络的入口打通之后，[leader.GetName]正着手寻找通讯信号的源头。
texts.en:
Excavation work has uncovered fragmented debris within the impact crater on [from.Planet.GetName]. These shattered pieces are emitting strong traces of the gravitational radiation previously detected from orbit.

With access to the subsurface cavern network secured [leader.GetName] is now ready to trace the communications signal to its source.

texts.zh:
我们找到了[from.Planet.GetName]上通讯信号的源头：一座深深穿透行星地壳且结构损坏的巨大设施。

尽管通讯阵列由于接触酸性环境而发生腐蚀，但它仍在以一种不明语言发出通讯，尝试与远方的实体联络。

我们用特制的重力夹把这台装置夹好后又牢牢地固定在基岩上。需要进一步研究才能确定其实际用途。
texts.en:
We have traced the communications signal on [from.Planet.GetName] to its source: a large, structurally-damaged construct which has deeply penetrated the planet's crust.

Corroded from acidic exposure, its communications array continues to transmit in an unfamiliar language, attempting to make contact with a distant entity.

Secured in place with specialized gravitational clamps, the device is firmly anchored in the bedrock. Further research will be necessary to ascertain its true purpose.

texts.zh:
经过我们细致的分析，现在终于部分弄明白这台[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置的作用了。这台机器是一种粗糙且具有破坏性的环境改造装置。

它旨在通过目标资源的受激辐射增长来照射本地生物圈，在此过程中引起级联效应，破坏星球的生态系统。该过程以提高整颗行星的毒性为代价，为其使用者带来大量容易开采的资源。

尽管这种过程的具体原理我们并未完全理解，但这台装置的通讯频率已经顺利解码，从中还发现两个发出一样信号的地点。
texts.en:
After detailed analysis, we now have a partial understanding of the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName]. This machine is a crude and destructive terraforming device.

Designed to irradiate native biospheres through stimulated radiation growth of targeted resources, it causes a cascading effect that devastates the planet's ecosystem in the process. This provides its user with abundant extractable materials at the cost of raising general toxicity across the planet.

While the exact workings of this process remain only partially understood, we have successfully decoded the device's communications frequency, identifying two additional locations transmitting the same signal.

texts.zh: 这项技术背后的锐意创业者显然对利润优化有着浓厚的兴趣，我们可以追寻着这一发现学到很多东西。
texts.en: The entrepreneurial trailblazers behind this technology clearly had an affinity for profit streamlining, we could learn a great deal from pursuing this discovery.

texts.zh: 调查这些地点或许能获得更多关于这项科技的洞见。
texts.en: Investigating these sites may yield further insight into the technology.

texts.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]上的一台毁坏的环境改造装置残骸依旧在向星系中的多个地点发出信号。调查这些地点可以揭开更多关于这项危险科技的秘密。
texts.en: The remains of a destructive terraforming device on [from.Planet.GetName] continue to emit a signal to multiple locations across the galaxy. Investigating these sites will reveal more information about this dangerous technology.
